texts.Portfolio or Reels: Honest note: no video reel. My portfolio is long-form writing and published research: https://tonydzi.github.io/ - 50+ published items, 136 citations (Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=b8gKHiMAAAAJ) - 110 public repos at https://github.com/tonydzi - currently writing a book on human-AI collaboration (AIBO - The Partner).
texts.Why do you want to work at Mobbin?: Mobbin sets a high craft bar for design content, and its library is a reference point for product teams. My strength is editorial: turning complex product and research material into clear, engaging content - docs, courses, long-form articles - and I run a 169k-subscriber Telegram channel ([аккаунт]). I would like to apply that editorial sense to Mobbin's YouTube content.
texts.Your availability & preferred working st: Full-time or contract availability, remote from Lisbon, Portugal (UTC+0/+1), comfortable overlapping with US and APAC hours; async-first, independent working style.
texts.A few lines on a video you'd improve: Honest note first: I have not yet done a scene-by-scene pass on a specific Mobbin video, so rather than invent one - the pattern I most often fix in product/design videos: slow cold opens. I would cut straight to the product in motion within the first 3 seconds, tighten pacing with jump-cuts, add on-screen captions for sound-off viewing, and end with one concrete CTA instead of a generic outro.
